acceptance: Fork generator produces the SQL the BenchBox helpers produce for DATE +/- INTERVAL, EXTRACT, DATE_TRUNC and month intervals, proven by tests that execute the SQL on sqlite3 and compare values and types.
The generic BETWEEN fold has execution tests and does not reference TPC-H names.
Output differences versus the BenchBox helpers over the existing tests/unit/utils/test_dialect_utils.py inputs are listed in the PR.
Fork make check, make benchbox-dist and make benchbox-check pass; PR merged; patches.json updated.
description: BenchBox _fix_sqlite_unsupported_syntax (regex) and _fold_sqlite_discount_bounds still run after translation; the runtime baseline lists sqlite-unknown-extract and sqlite-month-interval as retain. Move the behavior into the fork's SQLite generator as extensions of the carried sqlite-date-* patches, and expose the BETWEEN literal-arithmetic fold as a generic fork rewrite (BenchBox keeps the lineitem gate as an argument).
